name: monsocket-arcade
description: The Onchain Arcade — games built on monsocket. The Vault is game one.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:sdk && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.test: pnpm run build:sdk && node --experimental-strip-types tests/logic.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tests/bloom.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --no-network-family-autoselection tests/transport.ts
